title: Twitter Sentiment Analytics & Synthetic Boost
summary: A reproducible Twitter sentiment analysis pipeline that cleans text, engineers BoW/TF-IDF features, and trains Naive Bayes, Random Forest, and XGBoost classifiers. It addresses class imbalance by generating synthetic samples via SMOTE and, using SDV's TVAESynthesizer, fitting and sampling synthetic tweet-feature data to augment the training set.
evidence: src/synthetic_generator.py:99-108 imports TVAESynthesizer, fits it on selected columns, and generates synthetic samples; main.ipynb:1135-1139 calls synthesizer.fit/sample
